name: LLWYNOG
source:
A visual novel in three acts about a fox trying to understand cat and dog society. Some scattered thoughts on being intersex, autistic, and schizophrenic explored through medieval stories and folk tales, and ultimately finding mediation in alienation.

[From [url=https://cadnomori.itch.io/llwynog]itch.io[/url]]
